subject: Architecture
title: The Empire State Building: Racing the Sky
description: A quick, practical guide to The Empire State Building: Racing the Sky.

hook.text: The Empire State Building was built in 410 days — averaging four and a half floors per week.

buildup.text: It was a race. The Chrysler Building had just stolen the 'world's tallest' title with a secret spire.

discovery.text: Workers, many of them Mohawk ironworkers, walked steel beams 1,000 feet up without safety nets.

twist.text: It opened during the Depression and sat mostly empty for years. Critics called it the 'Empty State Building.'

climax.text: King Kong, tourist tickets, and TV antennas saved it financially — pop culture rescued real estate.

punchline.text: Built in 14 months. Took a decade to fill.

quiz.question: Why was the Empire State Building initially unprofitable?
options: Construction costs were triple the budget
It opened during the Great Depression and sat mostly empty
Zoning laws prevented businesses from occupying it
